problems: Cliopatria rows 'Principality of Monaco' and 'Kingdom of Monaco' (both Q235) are one state: merged into principality-of-monaco with both Names and all 9 shapes reviewed. The eu-20 batches that list kingdom-of-monaco as owned must not write a separate dossier; colours.json has a colour for each slug and the kingdom's is unused.

Every Cliopatria Monaco polygon is oversized (164.4 km2 pre-1848 for about 40 km2 of land; 94.1 and 47.0 km2 after for 2.084 km2) and the 1848-2024 ones lie west of Monaco (bbox 7.15-7.23E, France only). Marked wrong with {country: Monaco}; the grid (about 253 km2 per cell) cannot hold a 2 km2 state, so rendering needs a sub-cell rule: {country: Monaco} and the Cliopatria 1945 shape resolve to different cells.
Start year is 1297 (Grimaldi seizure, Monaco infobox 8 January 1297), not Cliopatria's 1642; new keyframes cover 1297-1641 and 1940-1944; Cliopatria's 1794-1813 gap is correct (French rule).

Six pages opened against a budget of five (merged row adds four shapes; the Franco-Monegasque Treaty page is a stub). Two fetches of History of Monaco summarised the page differently; only dated sentences the fetches quoted were used.
Pages disagree on the Italian occupation (Monaco page 1943, History of Monaco 11 November 1942) and on the 1861 act (2 vs 11 February 1861); both recorded in the ledger notes.
